scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Press Reporters of Puducherry
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for at least five years.
Applicant must be a press reporter.
Applicant must have served in a newspaper or magazine registered with the Registrar of Newspapers, Government of India, New Delhi.
The newspaper or magazine must have been continuously registered for at least ten years.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 is provided to eligible press reporters, disbursed by cheque within three weeks of application.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self-attested if required)
